places.normalized: Bell Yard, London (off Chancery Lane, Holborn)
places.quote: Then we all went to Bell Yard, a narrow alley at a very short distance.
places.note: Narrow alley; house numbers and exact location not given in passage.

places.quote: went back to Lincoln's Inn, where Mr. Skimpole, who had not cared to remain nearer Coavinses, awaited us.
places.note: Inn of Court; the party returns there briefly before going to Bell Yard.
